title: Payload: encounter-bundle/0.1 (rltp-delivery@0.79, target Trust Tasks framework 0.4)
description: Payload schema per Trust Tasks 6.3 ($id = Type URI, describes only the payload). One-scan transmission per Delivery Contract 4.1: the scanner's sent card and step credential. Consistency and validate-then-consume rules are normative in Delivery Contract 4.1/6.2.

card.description: the scanner's sent card: fresh sent-challenge, sentTo = the document recipient

credential.description: the scanner's step credential binding the recipient's displayed challenge
